automatable_note: A jumper is fitted on the two gold pins before power-up and stays on through phase 1; power is disconnected and reconnected between phases, and in phase 2 the jumper is pulled during the sequence to switch the cutoff off. The bench cannot place the jumper.

manual.action: Fit the jumper on the two gold pins; it stays on through phase 1.
Between phases: power off, pull the jumper, power on. Phase 2: pull it before the last flashes to switch cutoff off.

entry.confirm_signal: LED flash with a beep if the motor is connected after power-up.
steps: Operator: fit the jumper on the two gold pins. Radio on (opto types: receiver battery connected too).
Phase 1: throttle to brake (off) position, apply drive power; the LED flashes once.
Move to the max speed position; LED flashes. Move to the motor-off position; LED flashes.
Move to the brake speed position; LED flashes twice.
Disconnect power, pull the jumper, reconnect power.
Phase 2 (optional): throttle at max speed position, apply power; flash, then three flashes. Move to brake position for counter-clockwise or keep max for clockwise; three or four flashes confirm.
Cutoff: jumper still plugged at the final flash = cutoff on; pulled = cutoff off.
Arming switch (optional): pull the jumper and plug it again within about 5 s after phase 2; two flashes confirm.

announce.description: Signals are LED flashes (and a beep when the motor is connected): one flash per taught position; three flashes = clockwise, four flashes = counter-clockwise.

select.description: The throttle is moved to each requested stick position after each flash.

skip.description: Not applicable: the sequence has no menu; every step is taught in order.

scheme.confirm_signal: Flash patterns per step as described; two flashes after power-up signal readiness.
scheme.exit: Disconnect power and pull the jumper after each phase, then reconnect.
scheme.description: Two-phase teach-in: phase 1 stores the throttle positions and brake speed, phase 2 stores rotation direction, undervoltage cutoff and arming switch. The phases run separately.

items.name: Throttle positions (brake off, max speed, motor off) and brake speed (phase 1)

values.name: brake speed position at max speed: about 0.1 s to 100 % brake
brake speed position at middle: about 0.5 s
brake speed position at brake (off): minimum brake speed, about 2 s (English) or 3 s (German)
proportional brake: brake-speed position equals brake (off) position with enough distance to motor-off
on: jumper plugged at the last flash
enabled by pulling and re-plugging the jumper within about 5 s

unknowns: Item numbers are step order chosen here; the ESC does not sound item numbers.
Beep duration and spacing are not stated; only LED flashes and 'beep if the motor is connected'.
Time allowed between steps (stick moves) is not stated except the 5 s arming switch window.
Reset to defaults is not described.
notes: Brake speed at the minimum position: Kontronik_3P_en.pdf says about 2 s, Kontronik_3P_de.pdf says about 3 s.
The motor cables and sensor cables in the manual are for Aveox motors (sensored).
Phase 1 keeps the jumper on until the power is off; only phase 2 and the arming switch handle it during the sequence (Kontronik_3P_en.pdf p.3, p.5).
